svg: What a cadence commitment costs you: the same window, three frequenciesMonthly controle.g. an access review runevery month.A 3-month window gives theauditor three operations tosample — enough to form anopinion on whether the controlactually runs.Quarterly controle.g. a vendor security reviewrun each quarter.A 6-week window contains nocomplete cycle. There isnothing to sample, so thecontrol cannot be tested forthat period.Annual controle.g. a disaster-recovery testrun once a year.One operation exists per yearat best. A first report is thinon this control whateverwindow you choose — andbuyers read exactly these.No AICPA standard sets a minimum window — management determines the time frame (AICPA SOC 2 guide 1.39). Evidence sets the floor.
